//managed: Set false when you run herald-daemon yourself (systemd, a terminal). The plugin then only reads events.jsonl instead of spawning its own watcher.

llm.//maxBodyChars: How much of the message body is sent for classification.
llm.//maxTokens: 0 omits the cap entirely, which is what reasoning models want.

notify.//categories: Urgency per category, or "off" to record the event without a toast.
notify.//minConfidence: Verdicts below this are recorded but never raise a toast.

scan.//backfill: Messages to classify on first run for a mailbox. 0 means only new mail.
scan.//maxPerCycle: Ceiling on one batch, so a reconnect after a long offline spell cannot fire fifty toasts.
scan.//pollSeconds: Only used when the server has no usable IDLE.
scan.//senderDenylist: Case-insensitive regexes matched against the From header.
